```python
def solve(df: pl.DataFrame) -> pl.DataFrame:
    result = (
        df
        .group_by("d")
        .agg(
            a=pl.col("a").n_unique(),
            b=pl.col("b").n_unique()
        )
        .sort("d")
        .rename({"a": "a", "b": "b"})
    )
    return result
```

```python
def solve(east: pl.DataFrame, west: pl.DataFrame) -> pl.DataFrame:
    condition = (east["dur"] < west["time"]) | (west["rev"] < east["cost"])
    result = east.join(west, on=["id", "t_id"], how="inner")
    result = result.filter(condition)
    return result.select(["id", "dur", "rev", "cores", "t_id", "time", "cost", "cores_right"])
```

```python
def solve(east: pl.DataFrame, west: pl.DataFrame) -> pl.DataFrame:
    result = (
        east
        .join(
            west,
            on=["id", "t_id"],
            how="outer",
            strategy="left",
        )
        .filter(
            (pl.col("dur") < pl.col("time")) & (pl.col("rev") < pl.col("cost"))
        )
        .select(
            ["id", "dur", "rev", "cores", "t_id", "time", "cost", "cores_right"]
        )
        .sort(["id", "time"])
    )
    return result
```

```python
def solve(df_temporal: pl.DataFrame) -> pl.DataFrame:
    df = df_temporal.clone()
    df = df.with_columns(
        pl.int_range(0, len(df)).alias("index"),
        pl.col("date").alias("date"),
    )
    df = df.sort("date")
    df = df.with_columns(
        pl.col("date").dt.offset_by("2h").alias("date_2h_ago"),
        pl.col("date_2h_ago").is_between(
            pl.col("date_2h_ago").min(),
            pl.col("date_2h_ago").max(),
            closed="both"
        ).alias("in_window"),
        pl.col("in_window").sum().alias("rolling_row_min"),
    )
    return df.select(["index", "date", "rolling_row_min"]).sort("date")
```
